title: Hermeus crop-mark button
description: A flat grey slab button with a short uppercase label, tightened, and tiny black crop-mark ticks at its four corners. The fill turns amber on hover (0.25s ease-in-out).
notes: tone 'card' for white bands, 'secondary' for grey bands
scales with the window: 34px tall on phones, 44px at 1440
name: hermeus-button

props.name: tone
props.description: the resting fill: "card" (near-white, for white bands) or "secondary" (grey, for grey bands)
